ingredientSections.heading: Colcannon with Kale
items: ½ bunch kale, rinsed & cut into strips

methodSections.heading: Colcannon with Kale
steps: Boil the potatoes in seasoned water until they are tender and then rice them. If you don't have a ricer, push them through a fine mesh sieve or colander with the back of a large spoon.
To a pan add a good splash of olive oil, the minced garlic, green onions and shallots and cook on medium low heat until translucent.
Increase the temperature to high, add the kale and cook while stirring until it is vibrant and soft.

Heat the whipping cream, milk, buttermilk, nutmeg and butter together. Once hot, stir the cream mixture through the riced potato using a large spoon or spatula. When the liquid is incorporated, add and stir through the cooked kale. Season to taste.
Serve with a knob of butter on top and a pinch of fresh cracked black pepper.
You can optionally add chopped-up crispy strips of bacon.
